explication: SimpleTuner is a multimodal diffusion-model training toolkit with a Web UI, CLI, and multi-user worker platform. The principal workflow configures a training job, obtains and prepares data, trains a supported model, and monitors results; the Web UI also supports checkpoint inference and cloud-worker orchestration. The README documents broad capabilities, while sampled source shows selected server, process, inference, and model-pipeline behavior. Links for unsampled subsystems rely on README statements, not source inspection.
